seo.title: Solutions
seo.seo_title: AI solutions for small businesses in Quebec
seo.seo_description: Six AI solutions for Quebec small businesses: email, invoices, customer service, appointments, accounting and documents. Your team always keeps the decision.

blocks.role: Hub des solutions : promesse, deux CTA.

translation.headline: One real problem. One solution at a time.
translation.subheadline: Email, invoices, customer service, appointments, accounting, documents: six situations where well-supervised AI removes the retyping and leaves the decision to your team.

blocks.role: Six entrées par problème, chacune vers sa page.

translation.title: Six situations, six solutions.
translation.intro: Pick the one that looks like your week. Each page follows the same thread: the problem, what the system does, what your team receives, the expected benefit and what stays under your control.

cards.title: Email piling up.
cards.text: Sorting, digging up the history and a first draft take the whole morning. The system classifies, summarizes and prepares a draft reply.

cards.title: Invoices to retype.
cards.text: One supplier sends a PDF, another a photo. The system reads the documents, flags amounts that do not add up and files everything in a table.

cards.title: Customers who wait.
cards.text: The same questions keep coming. An agent answers from your documents, cites its sources and hands over to a person when it does not know.

cards.title: Appointments that slip.
cards.text: Requests outside opening hours, reminders done by hand, late cancellations. The system proposes slots and reminds, based on your calendar.

cards.title: Documents to key in.
cards.text: Month-end means data entry. The system prepares the pre-entry and flags discrepancies; the accountant keeps the decision.

cards.title: Documents you cannot find.
cards.text: The right clause, the right version, the right procedure. Ask in plain language; the answer comes from your own documents, with its sources.

blocks.role: Comment sont bâties ces solutions : sur WorkStudio, adaptées après diagnostic.

translation.title: Built on WorkStudio, fitted to you.
translation.body:
These solutions are not off-the-shelf boxes. They are configurations assembled in Nexora WorkStudio: agents (software that completes a task using the tools you authorize) linked by workflows (automated sequences of tasks).

Every go-live starts with a diagnosis of your case. We then check that your software can be connected, and we announce no universal timeline.

items.title: 1. The problem.
items.text: What costs you time, described in your own words.

items.title: 2. What the system does.
items.text: The steps, in order, and the ones that wait for a person.

items.title: 3. What your team receives.
items.text: The concrete result: drafts, tables, sourced answers.

items.title: 4. The expected benefit.
items.text: Described without invented figures; measured on a first case.

items.title: 5. What stays under your control.
items.text: The approvals, the access, the location of the data.

blocks.role: Quatre exemples non interchangeables, étiquetés comme exemples construits.

translation.title: Needs that do not look alike.
translation.intro: Four typical situations. These are constructed examples, not results measured at customers.

cards.title: A renovation contractor.
cards.text: They want to find old quotes, organize crews and track real costs. For construction and field services, OPSYS-AI brings these needs together in ten departments, each with its own status.

cards.title: A distributor.
cards.text: They receive price requests by email and supplier invoices in assorted formats. Email sorting and invoice reading are the two entry points.

cards.title: A professional-services firm.
cards.text: It hunts for the right clause in old files and prepares documents from templates. Searching its own documents is the first solution.

cards.title: A small practice that books appointments.
cards.text: It loses slots through forgetfulness and late cancellations. Requests, reminders and calendar handling are the core.

blocks.role: Ce que ces solutions ont en commun : le contrôle.

translation.title: A shared principle: control.
translation.body: Whatever the solution, four rules do not change.

items.title: A person decides.
items.text: In the workflows we set up, any action that commits the business (sending, paying, posting an entry) waits for a person's approval, unless you decide otherwise in writing.

items.title: Answers cite their sources.
items.text: When an agent searches your documents, it numbers and cites what it used.

items.title: Everything leaves a trace.
items.text: Every model call can be consulted: what was asked, what was answered, with which model.

items.title: You choose where it runs.
items.text: On your server, or in our infrastructure in Quebec. An external model comes in only with your written agreement.

blocks.role: Questions de départ sur les solutions.

items.question: Where do we start?
items.answer: With the problem that costs you the most time. We describe it with you, check which software must be connected, then put a first case into service before expanding.

items.question: Do I have to change my software?
items.answer: Generally not: the system connects to what you already use. Whether a given piece of software can be connected depends on the service concerned; we check it during the diagnosis.

items.question: Is it ready to use?
items.answer: No, and deliberately so: each solution is configured for your business, with your rules and your documents. What is delivered are the building blocks of WorkStudio.

items.question: What about the phone?
items.answer: No call-answering service is delivered today. A voice message dropped in as a recording can be transcribed; live telephony is checked separately, case by case.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet. After the diagnosis, we provide a written estimate that states what is included and what is not.

translation.title: Let's talk about your first case.
translation.text: Describe a concrete problem. We will tell you which of these solutions applies, in which mode, and where to start.
